BrochureContent.Content:
Gary O'Driscoll & Co. are proud to present 'Manorville', 3 Castle Demesne, a substantial five-bedroom detached dormer bungalow, ideally positioned in one of Tralee's most mature and sought-after residential developments.

Occupying a quiet cul-de-sac setting, this impressive family home is within walking distance of Tralee Town Centre and a host of excellent local amenities, including schools, shops, restaurants and recreational facilities. The property is presented in very good condition throughout and offers spacious, well-proportioned accommodation, making it an ideal family home.

The residence benefits from oil-fired central heating, white PVC double-glazed windows throughout, all mains services and off-street parking. Externally, the property boasts a large, private rear garden, providing an excellent space for outdoor entertaining, family living or gardening.

Combining a highly desirable location with generous living accommodation and excellent presentation throughout, this is a superb opportunity to acquire a quality family home in one of Tralee's most established residential addresses.
